text: In which pyramid(s) the number of old people will be the least?
context:
In fig. 2.1, A, B and C are three population pyramids. Study their shapes and answer the questions that follow.

Pyramid (A): the bars are longest at the 0-5 band and shorten steadily at every higher age band, tapering to a very narrow apex above 80.

Pyramid (B): the bars are short at the base, widen upward, are longest in the 55-70 bands, and then taper to the apex.

Pyramid (C): the bars are of almost equal length from the base up to about age 60, after which they shorten towards the apex.

text: Comment upon the age-structure of its population.
context: The population pyramid of India for 2016 is given in fig. 2.2. In it the 0-5, 5-10, 10-15 and 15-20 bands are all close to the maximum of about 42 to 45 million for each sex, and every band above them is shorter than the one below, tapering to a very narrow apex at 100+.

text: Which region has the lowest literacy rate?
context:
Read the following graph in fig. 2.3 and answer the questions that follow :

Adult literacy rate by region and sex, 2016 (per cent)

| Region | Total | Male | Female |
|---|---|---|---|
| Central Asia | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Europe and Northern America | 99 | 99 | 99 |
| Eastern and South-Eastern Asia | 96 | 97 | 94 |
| Latin America and the Caribbean | 94 | 94 | 90 |
| Northern Africa and Western Asia | 81 | 85 | 74 |
| Southern Asia | 72 | 80 | 63 |
| Sub-Saharan Africa | 65 | 72 | 57 |
| World | 86 | 90 | 83 |
